details.question: How many orders are there in total?
details.candidate_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders;

details.question: Show me the top 5 customers by total orders in 2026
details.candidate_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_orders DESC LIMIT 5;

details.question: What products has customer Rahul Singh ordered?
details.candidate_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.name = 'Rahul Singh';

details.question: Show all orders that are still pending
What is the total revenue by product category?
details.candidate_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

details.question: Which product has been ordered the most?
details.candidate_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 1;

details.question: What is the average order value per customer?
details.candidate_sql: SELECT c.name, AVG(order_total) AS avg_order_value FROM customers c JOIN (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id) t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name;

details.question: Show customers who have never placed an order
details.candidate_sql: SELECT c.* FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL;

details.question: Find the top 3 selling products in the Electronics category
details.candidate_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_sold DESC LIMIT 3;
